Experiment 1: 10 people x 2 blocks x 44 trials = 880 recordings; Experiment 2: 8 people x 88 = 704
Experiment 2: each of the 4 stimlist codes occurs 22 times per participant
sample times are 10 ms apart in every recording

differences: The paper (J Vis 18(8):16, 2018) says Experiment 2 had one block of 44 trials; the deposit has 88 trials per participant (four stimulus codes of 22 each), so the 44 is not used as a check for Experiment 2.

The paper's gaze-bias results (critical fixation at first contact, contact asynchrony) are derived measures the deposit does not contain, so they are not reproduced; the checks are the design numbers (participants, trials, sampling rate).
The paper text was read from the VU Amsterdam repository copy (publisher version, CC BY-NC-ND); the data are CC BY 4.0.
